title: Opportunity stages
notice: Stage definitions are shared by pipelines. Each pipeline sets its own order.

actions.usedDeactivateDesc: Remove this stage from its pipelines before deactivating
actions.usedDeleteDesc: Remove this stage from its pipelines before deleting

footer.count: Stage definitions: {{count}} · each pipeline sets its own order

modal.nameArHint: Enter the Arabic stage name shared across sales pipelines (up to 80 characters).
modal.nameEnHint: Enter the English stage name shared across sales pipelines (up to 80 characters).
modal.meaningHint: Choose the operational meaning that controls stage rules and reporting.
modal.meaningSystemHint: System stage meaning cannot be changed.
modal.meaningUsedHint: Meaning cannot be changed while the stage is used by a pipeline.
modal.categoryHint: New pairs with Open, Won with Positive, Lost with Negative. No other meaning may use Open.
modal.activeHint: Inactive stages cannot be added to pipelines.
modal.activeUsedHint: Stages used by a pipeline cannot be deactivated.
modal.usedInHint: Renaming changes the name in every pipeline that uses this stage.

delete.title: Delete opportunity stage?
delete.text: “{{name}}” will be removed from the stage list. A stage used by a pipeline cannot be deleted.

inUse.title: Stage is in use
inUse.text: Remove this stage from its pipelines first: {{names}}.

discard.title: Discard unsaved changes?
discard.text: Your changes to this opportunity stage have not been saved.
